svg.title: Ilya project map, 1 October 2026, revision 8
svg.desc: A whole-project map of Ilya at 1 October 2026, replacing revision 7 of 10 August. It carries the ratified release sentence, then nine zones: what a singer opens, getting a piece in, the voice, Markup, Insights, the Guide and outreach, the French, open defects, and Code's queue. Then the schedule to the release target and what is out or later. Outline rather than colour carries status, so the map survives greyscale.
svg.text: project map, 1 October 2026, REVISION 8. Replaces revision 7 of 10 August. Branch Shane. Last ship 14e4cb5; desk records at 57f76ec.
shipped, not yet walked by Dann
What the release says it does · the release sentence, ratified by Dann 13 September
“Ilya takes your text, your score, and your voice, and gives you three supports on the page: a formatted IPA transcription, a reading of where the piece
will sit well for you and where it will not, and insights to help you decide whether to sing it.”

Release target Friday 30 October, A TARGET, NOT A WALL (Dann, 26 September). Quality over speed: the date never sizes the work (CONTRACT, posture 6). The beta keeps PDF and photograph. MIDI IS OUT, ruled 1 October.
1 · What a singer opens · five tabs, three drawer bands (i18n.ts:104-119; Drawer.svelte:516-553)
Transcribes on paste; no button any more
The score, with the voice drawn on it
How the piece meets the voice
A course in Russian lyric diction
THE DRAWER: Piece (name, repertoire, export and import) · Input (one field for poem and score; Notation; Analysis) · Voice (calibration). On a narrow screen, a Drawer/Paper pull.
The Analysis station starts closed and a word click does not open it (memo-n84-path-map §4b). HELD, not raised: a tether-22 candidate.

Gates at the last ship: all eight at baseline, gate 4 at 1784 tests.
No agent commits. Dann ships with ilya-ship.sh.
A brief enters QUEUE.md when written and leaves when shipped.
The desk does not build; Code builds on Dann's machine.
The road to 30 October · SCHEDULE.md, ticked 1 October
THE FREEZE RULE: a new finding joins only if Ilya would otherwise tell a singer something false or lose a singer's work. When work and date disagree, the date moves.
Out for good, and what changed since revision 7
MIDI, ruled out entirely 1 October. Ilya refuses a MIDI file and says what to export instead.
There is no teacher mode: all users are users (Dann, 23 September).
Fit became Markup and Insights; Transcription became Text; Corrections left the drawer for the loupe;
the Transcribe button went; the voice got its own band; the record moved into docs/memory in the repository.
HOW THIS MAP WAS MADE: from STATE.md, SCHEDULE.md, QUEUE.md, OPEN.md, and PRODUCT.md read on 1 October, the control map memo-n84-path-map_r1_2026-10-01.md, and the overnight memos.
Every status is the record's, not a fresh walk of the app. Where the record and the tree disagree, the tree wins.
